items.title: Balancing Function and Aesthetics: Clinical Insights from Contemporary Rhinoplasty in a Regional Middle Eastern Cohort
items.fact_zh: 263例中东初次鼻整形，ROE从31.5升到84.8分，报告零重大并发症、零翻修。
items.take_zh: 满意度涨53分好看，但随访期零翻修不合常理，更像随访短或失访，别照抄这组数。
items.scene_zh: 这个满意度分数先别急着信，得问他们随访了多久。
items.fact_en: In 263 primary rhinoplasties by a single surgeon, ROE improved from 31.5 to 84.8, with no major complications or revisions reported.
items.take_en: A 53-point ROE gain alongside zero revisions over follow-up points to short or incomplete follow-up rather than surgical superiority.

items.title: The L-Shaped Lateral Crural Graft: A Single-Graft Technique for the Correction of Alar Concavity and Nasal Valve Insufficiency
items.fact_zh: 12例翻修鼻用肋软骨L形外侧脚支架，随访9.5个月，无感染、外露、变形。
items.take_zh: 12例、无对照、无客观通气测量，“全部满意”只能算可行性信号，不能算疗效。
items.scene_zh: 鼻翼塌、鼻阀窄的翻修可以留一块L形肋软骨，但别承诺一次到位。
items.fact_en: Twelve revision patients received bilateral L-shaped costal cartilage lateral crural grafts; at a mean 9.5 months there were no infections, exposures, warping or recurrences.
items.take_en: Twelve uncontrolled cases judged by surgeon and patient report show feasibility only, not efficacy.

items.title: High vs Low Septal Preservation Rhinoplasty: A Quantitative Morphologic Analysis of Hump-Supratip Dynamics
items.fact_zh: 30例保留鼻整形照片测量：高鼻中隔组鼻尖上区下降更多，低鼻中隔组相对更高。
items.take_zh: 样本30、非随机、随访短；能说两种做法鼻尖上区反应不同，不能说哪个更好。
items.scene_zh: 选高鼻中隔就得接受鼻尖上区掉得多一点，术前先讲清。
items.fact_en: In 30 preservation rhinoplasties measured on standardized photographs, the high septal technique lowered the supratip more while the low septal approach left it relatively higher.
items.take_en: Thirty non-randomized cases with short follow-up describe how the two variants move the supratip, not which one is better.

items.title: The Next Step in Facial Aesthetic Surgery Outcome Evaluation: Quantifying Classical Deep Plane versus Preservation Facelift with 3-Dimensional Surface Imaging
items.fact_zh: 32例拉皮6个月3D测量：保留式中面部横向位移4.75mm，深平面2.54mm。
items.take_zh: 位移大不等于好看，分组按时间先后而非随机，耐久性作者自己也没测。
items.scene_zh: 别拿毫米数跟病人许诺，拉得多不代表拉得好。
items.fact_en: In 32 patients imaged at six months, the preservation facelift displaced the medial midface 4.75 mm laterally versus 2.54 mm for the deep plane lift.
items.take_en: More displacement is not a better face, allocation followed chronology rather than randomization, and durability was not measured.

items.title: Postoperative nausea and vomiting after facelift surgery despite routine dual antiemetic prophylaxis
items.fact_zh: 220例拉皮，常规双联止吐后62.3%仍恶心呕吐，49.1%真的吐了。
items.take_zh: 同期做眼睑、手术时间长是独立危险因素，Apfel评分反而没用；单中心预印本。
items.scene_zh: 拉皮加眼睑一起做、时间又长的，止吐别只按常规两联。
items.fact_en: Despite dual antiemetic prophylaxis in 96% of 220 facelift patients, 62.3% had PONV within 24 hours and 49.1% vomited.
items.take_en: Concurrent blepharoplasty and longer operating time independently predicted PONV while the Apfel score did not; this is a single-centre preprint.

items.title: Breast augmentation and sensory outcomes: A systematic review of surgical techniques and their impact on nipple-areola complex and breast-skin sensibility
items.fact_zh: 26项研究、9190例隆胸：感觉减退多在6-12个月恢复，乳晕切口早期低感觉更多。
items.take_zh: 证据只能定性汇总、测量工具各异；可用于术前告知，不能用来给切口排名。
items.scene_zh: 乳晕切口感觉恢复慢一些，多半会好，这个术前就要说。
items.fact_en: Across 26 studies and 9,190 patients, most sensory loss after augmentation recovered within 6 to 12 months, with more early nipple hypoesthesia after periareolar incisions.
items.take_en: Heterogeneous measures forced a qualitative synthesis, so this informs consent rather than ranking incisions.
